subject: CAIQ control claim packaging and proof portal onboarding
messages:
From: audit@cloudassure.com
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: security-eng@pilotbank.com
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot Bank CAIQ: packaging guidance and preferred ingest method

Hi Grace / Redwood team,

We're kicking off the CAIQ intake for Pilot Bank. To keep the audit window tight, we'd like a compact package that:
- maps each CAIQ question to your control ID (one row per claim)
- includes one representative artifact (log, config, diagram) per claim where available
- provides a short rationale for claims that are covered by compensating controls

Operational asks: do you prefer a single ZIP upload to our SFTP, or presigned S3/Drive links per artifact? Also please confirm a point-of-contact for control-level clarifications (we often ask follow-ups about retention windows and sampling).

Target timeline: evidence package by Tue 2025-04-15 to allow sampling before the audit week.

Thanks,
Alex Romero
CloudAssure - Security Assessments
attachment: pilot_caiq_scope_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: audit@cloudassure.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, security-eng@pilotbank.com
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot Bank CAIQ: packaging guidance and preferred ingest method

Alex — thanks for the clear ask. We'll produce a compact manifest (CSV) mapping CAIQ IDs to Redwood control IDs, the selected artifact filename, and a 1-2 sentence rationale.

Quick answers:
- We can deliver presigned S3 links and a single manifest CSV; large runtime captures we'll hand off via presigned links (easiest for us).
- Internal PoC for clarifications: Kimberly Park (cc'd) — she'll triage control questions and route to owners.

Proposed MAP (mutual action plan):
1) Mon 2025-04-14: Redwood uploads initial artifact set + manifest to the proof portal (presigned S3 + Drive mirror).
2) Tue 2025-04-15: CloudAssure does sampling pass and sends any follow-ups per-control.
3) Wed 2025-04-16: Redwood resolves any follow-ups; final package delivered.

Kimberly — can you confirm which teams will produce runtime log samples vs config screenshots? Marissa, tagging for legal/contract redaction guidance (do we need to remove customer identifiers from logs?).

Cheers,
Grace O'Connor
Manager, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference
attachment: evidence_manifest_template.csv (csv)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, audit@cloudassure.com
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2025 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot Bank CAIQ: packaging guidance and preferred ingest method

Grace / Alex — quick update from engineering:
- Runtime logs: we will pull a 24-hour sample from the dedicated ingest cluster (anonymized) and produce a truncated tar.gz (runtime_log_snippet_202503.zip).
- Configs: owner teams will export control plane screenshots and the infra-as-code snippets (limited to the control-relevant sections).

Two logistics Qs for the auditors:
1) Accepting presigned S3 links that expire in 7 days? (we'll add MD5 checksums in the manifest)
2) Do you need signed attestations for controls where we point to external vendor attestations (third-party SSO, KMS)?

We'll upload the initial bundle and manifest by EOD today to the Drive folder listed below and generate presigned S3 links for the larger archives.

—Kimberly
Principal, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: runtime_log_snippet_202503.zip (zip)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: audit@cloudassure.com
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2025 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot Bank CAIQ: packaging guidance and preferred ingest method

Thanks team — legal checked in. A couple of notes before we hand artifacts to CloudAssure:
- Redaction: remove any customer PII from logs (mask IPs, token ids). Engineering: please use the redaction script in /shared/compliance/redaction_v2 before upload.
- Doc sign: for a few claims, Pilot Bank wants signed operational attestation PDFs. I'll draft a short attestation template and circulate for the relevant owners to sign.

I've uploaded the manifest (redwood_evidence_manifest_v1.csv) and a Drive invite to your address, Alex: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cProofPortalInvite.

Next steps for audit team: confirm you can consume presigned S3 links and whether you require the signed attestation PDFs before sampling (we can prioritize).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success (ops liaison)
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_evidence_manifest_v1.csv (csv)
